text:
invoice-bot: New invoice uploaded by Sunridge Supplies: INV-9876 — Amount: $12,450. No PO attached. Vendor notes 2% early-pay discount if paid within 10 days. PDF: https://redwood.app/invoices/INV-9876.pdf
Maya K: Saw this. No PO — who owns Sunridge at Redwood?
Jonah (Ops): I think this was for facility replenishment for the monthly events box? but amount seems higher than normal.
Lex R: Ran a vendor/PO search — closest match is PO-3012-FF (Facilities/Events) for $9,000 issued last year. Not a match.
Nate D: Tagging @Sophie P for AP/approver lookup — Sophie, can you confirm approver or whether vendor is in our approved list?
Sophie P: Checking vendor record now. Sunridge is in vendor master but under limited scope — no standing PO. Will need approver for this amount.
Maya K: Per finance policy, invoices >$5k need a PO or a written finance exception + approver. Vendor is offering 2% (≈$249). If we want the discount we need to either get a retro PO or vendor to extend terms.
Jonah (Ops): Can Procurement create a retro PO? That usually requires request from the owning team with cost center and approval. Who is the owning team for this purchase?
Nate D: Looks like the charge was routed from a request by Dedicated Infra — pinging @Lex R (was on the ticket). Lex, confirm cost center.
Lex R: Confirmed — this should hit ENG-DEVINFRA (cost center ENG-DI). Approver would be Procurement/Eng Approver chain.
Maya K: Procurement lead (Aisha) is OOO til Friday. If we wait, vendor due date may pass (they asked 10 days). Sophie, can AP request a due-date extension?
Sophie P: Yes we can ask. I'll send the standard extension request template and cc Maya. I'll also ask vendor if they can accept a retro PO + invoice annotation for reconciliation.
Maya K: If they won't extend, do we have a manual override process to take the 2% and then reconcile with a retro PO later?
Sophie P: Manual override exists but requires Procurement sign-off. We can do a provisional hold and payment authorization once Procurement approves.
Jonah (Ops): To speed things, I'll draft a retro PO template we can use. Paste below.
Jonah (Ops): ```
PO Draft:
Vendor: Sunridge Supplies
Invoice: INV-9876
Amount: 12,450
Cost center: ENG-DEVINFRA (ENG-DI)
Approver: Procurement (Aisha or delegate)
Notes: Retro PO for one-off replenishment. Approval pending.
```
Maya K: Thanks. Sophie — please do the extension email and flag the invoice in NetSuite as PO-MISSING / AWAITING-APPROVER.
Sophie P: On it. Email sent to AP@sunridge and cc procurement@redwood. Subject: Request to extend payment terms for INV-9876. I asked them to confirm extension to 30 days and to provide any supporting docs for a retro PO.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-9876 flagged: hold_code=PO-MISSING, status=on-hold.
Lex R: I set a manual pending flag on the internal ticket (backfill required once PO issued).
Nate D: If vendor confirms extension, we can avoid override. If not, Procurement will need to approve provisional payment to capture discount.
Sophie P: Vendor replied: "We can extend to 30 days if Redwood provides a PO within 5 business days." They attached a signed remittance confirmation.
Maya K: Great. We'll proceed with retro PO workflow. Jonah, loop Procurement for fast approval.
Jonah (Ops): Looping Procurement slack: @Aisha /procurement — need rapid approval for retro PO (PO draft above) to capture 2% early pay. Approver OOO status noted.
Maya K: I'll escalate to procurement backup.
Sophie P: Updating invoice status to AWAITING-PO. Will follow up when PO is created.
Maya K: :white_check_mark: Thanks team — moving to 'awaiting vendor/PO' and will update when procurement signs off.
